bootstrap.method: paired nonparametric training-seed bootstrap; one shared three-index draw refits all 15 curves and recomputes all 12 tuned-minimum differences
bootstrap.simultaneous_interval_method: 95th percentile of the valid-draw maximum absolute deviation from the 12 point estimates; one common unstudentized radius

analysis.estimand: quadratic tuned minimum(momentum arm) minus quadratic tuned minimum(mu0) at the same T
